title: SEA LIFE Michigan Aquarium Admission Ticket
includes: Admission to Legoland Discovery Center MIchigan (if option selected)
Admission to Legoland Discovery Center Michigan (if option not selected) (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Combo Ticket Child Policy: To promote a family-friendly environment, adults cannot enter LEGOLAND Discovery Center without being accompanied by a child
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: SEA LIFE Michigan is the state’s largest aquarium, home to over 250 species and 2,000 creatures including sharks, rays, and green sea turtles. Explore freshwater lakes and ocean depths while getting hands-on at the Interactive Touchpool, where you can feel crabs, sea stars, and more. Finish your visit walking through the stunning Underwater Ocean Tunnel, surrounded by thousands of colorful tropical fish swimming overhead.
